title: Model capability vocabulary — v1 (frozen)
description: Vocabulary a model-inference node (LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 node category 'model inference') uses to declare what it needs from whichever model eventually binds to it, and what a ModelDescriptor (05_INTEGRATION_CONTRACTS §9, the ASOM contract addendum) advertises it can provide. Distinct from capability-ids.v1 (authority/side-effect capabilities) — this registry is purely about MODEL FEATURE compatibility, feeding CMP-001..007 target-constraint evaluation and LOOP-COMPAT-001.

tags.description: Structured function/tool-call output the runtime can parse deterministically.
Can be constrained to emit schema-valid JSON output.
Supports a context window at or above a node-declared contextTokens threshold.
Exposes per-token logprob/entropy from the first token (InferenceEngine plumbing requirement carried over from the base app spine — CLAUDE.md 'why llama.cpp over Ollama').
Supports token-by-token or SSE streaming output.
Produces a fixed-size embedding vector rather than generated text (feeds semantic search M4, currently blocked on a real on-device embedder replacing PlaceholderEmbedder).
Produces image output (cloud or on-device Stable Diffusion).

Model MAY be resolved to run fully on-device (no network egress). Loop nodes SHOULD prefer this tag per the sovereignty default (binding rule 2) unless the node explicitly requests cloud-only quality.
Model resolves to a cloud provider call. Always implies fb.model.cloud_inference (capability-ids.v1) and a visible 'watched object' badge.
Model MAY be resolved via ASOM (127.0.0.1:11435) with shared-residency memory-budget negotiation against other apps holding the same weights (05_INTEGRATION_CONTRACTS §9).

modelDescriptorShape.note: Mirrors 05_INTEGRATION_CONTRACTS §9 ModelDescriptor — restated here as the producer side of this vocabulary, not redefined.
fields: capabilityTags (array of tag ids from this registry)

compatibilityRule: A model-inference node's required capability tags MUST be a subset of the resolved ModelDescriptor's capabilityTags at bind time, or the resolution fails with LOOP-COMPAT-001 (impossible target constraint) rather than silently degrading (e.g. silently dropping a tool-calling requirement and hoping the model complies in free text).
